description: This file contains unit tests for the SkillDao class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing CRUD and search functionalities related to skills.

classes.name: SkillDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to verify the functionality of the SkillDao data access object, including methods for retrieving, deleting, searching, saving, and editing skills in the system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment; creates an instance of SkillDao and populates test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetSkillById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a skill by ID and verifies the skill's name and description.

methods.name: testDeleteSkill
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple skills by IDs and asserts the number of deleted records.

methods.name: testSearchSkill
methods.description: Tests the search functionality for skills with default filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchSkillWithLimit
methods.description: Tests the skill search with limit parameter to restrict results.

methods.name: testSaveSkill
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new skill, verifying the saved skill’s properties.

methods.name: testEditSkill
methods.description: Tests editing an existing skill and verifying the updated properties.

methods.name: testGetSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the total number of skills matching search criteria.
